Hey guys. I need a hand with a Data Engineering issue. I am currently being tested to solve a pyspark challenge. I do know (or at least think I do) how I could solve it, but I do not know enough of AWS. They created an S3 Bucket in AWS and what I believe are some temporary credentials to authenticate and the data.
I have no issue connecting with BOTO3, but I think they want the connection directly with pyspark.

Is it possible for me to create a local spark session and calling the data from the S3 Bucket?

If you have resources on where I can read about this, it would be highly appreciated.

I don't have access to log into the AWS Cloud console or the platform in general other than the S3 bucket through Boto3, so I don't know what version of what they are currently using nor I can change any configuration on the AWS server side
